messages:
Priya (CSM): Heads up — MapleHealth onboarding stalled. Usage flat for 6 days, renewal in 21 days. Seeing token spikes and intermittent 502s on their Dedicated instance. Need a rapid save plan.
Ava (AM): Oof. Can you dump the quick health metrics and the main asks? Also who owns enablement? @Priya
Priya (CSM): Mateo owns integration enablement, Riley on support. Customer wants faster onboarding, lower short-term cost, and a simple fallback if they need to downgrade.
Mateo (Success Eng): I can take triage tomorrow and make a short runbook + recorded walkthrough.
Riley (Support): I flagged 502s on 2025-03-07 14:12–14:18. OpsBot alerted; a cache-shard restart was performed and latency improved.
OpsBot: Incident alert: cache-shard-4 restart executed at 2025-03-07T14:20:03Z — automation ran, latency trending down.
Ava (AM): Proposed save steps: 1) immediate triage call, 2) targeted credits + training offer, 3) "downgrade escape" path (preserve exports + short SLA), 4) follow-up cadence. Thoughts? :thinking_face:
Priya (CSM): Love it. Draft offer: 2 weeks of free Dedicated credits + a 1-hr onboarding workshop + a tech liaison for 30 days. If they still want to downgrade, offer migration support and a 2-week complimentary Starter bridge.
Mateo (Success Eng): I can produce a 12-min walkthrough video and a 1-pager escape path. Will include specific cost-control knobs (batching, quantization profiles).
Riley (Support): I'll prepare logs and a short postmortem to share on the call.
Priya (CSM): Quick checklist to share in the call:
```
- Confirm success criteria
- Show saved prompts + prefix/KV caching benefits
- Walk through cost controls (batching, quantization)
- Verify export/retention options and migration steps
- Offer trial credits + schedule workshop
```
Ava (AM): I'll log the offer in Gainsight and propose the credit amount. @Priya can you confirm final wording?
Priya (CSM): Draft wording: "We want MapleHealth to hit production goals. We'll provide 2 weeks of Dedicated credits, a 1-hour guided workshop, and one-touch migration support if you decide to move to Starter."
Mateo (Success Eng): Also recommend a phased A/B rollout: limit concurrency on new routes, add KV cache warmers, and monitor top tokens.
Riley (Support): I'll join the workshop and surface the runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/maplehealth-onboard
Ava (AM): Who owns follow-up cadence? Recommend daily check-ins for 3 days, then every 3 days until renewal.
Priya (CSM): I'll own daily check-ins for first 3 days. Assigning: @Mateo workshop (ETA 48h), @Riley postmortem + logs (ETA 24h), @Ava credits + contract note (ETA 12h).
OpsBot: Reminder set: follow-up-checkin MapleHealth in 3 days.
Priya (CSM): If downgrade still on table after workshop, we enact the 'downgrade escape' flow: paid migration window, export verification, mapped feature-parity checklist. I'll prep the contract amendment.
Ava (AM): I'll loop in Legal for amendment template and confirm the credits.
Priya (CSM): Meeting scheduled: 2025-03-09 16:00 PST. :calendar: Ping me if any blockers.
Mateo (Success Eng): ack.
Riley (Support): ack.
Ava (AM): :thumbsup:
